name: Pediatrics
boundaries: Pediatrics: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe, systemic reversal of autism spectrum disorder
original_dispositions.reason: The claim treats autism as one reversible pathophysiology. Monogenic syndromes with a known missing gene product are PED-09. Reopening a closed plasticity window is PED-04. A single therapy that normalizes social communication and repetitive behavior across idiopathic autism was not supported as one capability.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete functional regeneration of the neonatal brain after hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy
original_dispositions.reason: The entry’s demand for restored architecture is now explicit as a stricter proposed demonstration. The concept was not split into a second ID.

original_dispositions.original_title: One-time curative therapy for all childhood leukemias and high-risk solid tumors
original_dispositions.reason: Cure of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia is an achieved advance, and the remaining cancers do not share one lesion that a single course could hit. The uniformly fatal developmental brainstem tumor is PED-10. Extending that result to other solid tumors is stated there as a further discovery.

original_dispositions.original_title: Definitive cause and universal prevention of sudden infant death syndrome
original_dispositions.reason: Harrington and colleagues, eBioMedicine, 6 May 2022 (doi:10.1016/j.ebiom.2022.104041; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9092508/), found lower butyrylcholinesterase activity in newborn spots from infants who later died of SIDS. A 2024 mouse study found that loss of the enzyme did not impair neonatal autoresuscitation (https://journals.physiology.org/doi/10.1152/physiol.2024.39.S1.2079). A December 2024 genetic study found no overall association of selected acetylcholinesterase or butyrylcholinesterase variants with SIDS (doi:10.3390/genes15121656; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39766923/). The syndrome remains a triple-risk problem. Safe-sleep campaigns were the achieved population intervention. A unitary undiscovered switch was not isolated, so the item stays an unsolved problem rather than a specified capability.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe, permanent cure for type 1 diabetes in children
original_dispositions.reason: A one-time restoration of insulin production and immune tolerance would be transformative, and the disease often begins in childhood. The central unsolved mechanism is immune tolerance and beta-cell replacement, shared with adult disease, rather than a pediatric developmental principle. This pass did not find a child-specific barrier that would place the discovery inside pediatrics rather than endocrinology and immunology.

original_dispositions.original_title: Reliable early biomarker panel and preventive intervention for cerebral palsy
original_dispositions.reason: The preventive and regenerative intervention is the revolutionary piece. A test that only sorts risk, without changing the outcome, would be incremental and was not given its own ID.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal, one-time gene therapy platform for all severe inborn errors of metabolism detectable at birth
original_dispositions.reason: Added as PED-11, narrowed. “All” metabolic genes, including disorders confined to the brain, is not one delivery problem. The capability that meets the bar is a reusable hepatic edit given before irreversible injury.

original_dispositions.original_title: Root-cause molecular cure for juvenile idiopathic arthritis and other pediatric autoimmune diseases
original_dispositions.reason: Added as PED-13, narrowed to a drug-free immune reset with returning host defense. Early CAR T remissions are in refractory lupus, myositis, and scleroderma, not in ordinary juvenile idiopathic arthritis, and follow-up is measured in months.

original_dispositions.original_title: Non-invasive, precise in-utero correction of major congenital anomalies
original_dispositions.reason: Congenital diaphragmatic hernia, myelomeningocele, and congenital heart disease do not share one molecular lesion that a single non-invasive platform would correct. Open fetal repair of myelomeningocele is an achieved surgical advance. Genetic diseases that distort development before birth are PED-06. Replacing Fontan physiology is PED-07, whether the route is postnatal or fetal.

original_dispositions.original_title: Master regulatory switch for immune tolerance in pediatric solid-organ transplantation
original_dispositions.reason: Added as PED-12, narrowed. The 2025 phase 3 result is adult, HLA-matched, living-donor kidney transplantation. The open revolutionary capability is drug-free tolerance for the mismatched and thoracic organs transplanted into growing children.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PED-01 through PED-10 kept their IDs and concepts.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: No first-pass concept was deleted, replaced, or merged away.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PED-05 now states that full architectural regeneration is a stricter proposed demonstration of the same capability, and that a biomarker alone is not the concept.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The entry’s demand for restored architecture is now explicit as a stricter proposed demonstration. The concept was not split into a second ID.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PED-06 records the conflict between the NIH grant abstract and the not-yet-recruiting NCT07479953 listing; no human prenatal dose is claimed.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The grant abstract and the trial listing therefore disagree about how close the study is to opening; both agree that no fetus has been dosed.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PED-08 now names Carpenter and colleagues (doi:10.1016/j.ekir.2023.10.032) and Little and Humphreys (doi:10.1681/ASN.2021081073).
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Not established in the research notes.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PED-10 no longer carries an incomplete DOI for the November 2026 review; the ScienceDirect URL and article number are cited, with abstract-only access stated.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: A DOI string was not displayed on the page retrieved, so none is asserted.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PED-02 now identifies the EMBO Journal item as a commentary; the primary Chandler paper was not opened.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The primary Chandler article was not opened in this pass.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PED-11 added. The historical “universal gene therapy for every inborn error” was narrowed to a reusable in vivo hepatic platform given before irreversible metabolic brain injury.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The 2025 N-of-1 CPS1 edit and the terminated methylmalonic-acidemia trial show components, not the platform.
Adult HLA-matched kidney tolerance in 2025 is real and restricted. The open capability is drug-free tolerance for the mismatched and thoracic grafts children receive, lasting through growth.

A 2026 eight-child CAR T series shows short-term drug-free improvement in lupus, myositis, and scleroderma. That is not yet a durable reset of pediatric autoimmune disease as a class, and juvenile idiopathic arthritis was not in the series.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Overlaps are flagged inside PED-04, PED-05, PED-06, PED-07, PED-09, PED-11, PED-12, and PED-13.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: No first-pass concept was deleted, replaced, or merged away.
